observable_failure_step.description: Attempted to physically unlink the stale validation report in 03_deliverables/legacy_validation/validation_report.json, but a dynamic invariant rule deadlock blocked the deletion tool.

root_cause_diagnosis: A dynamic invariant rule deadlock occurred during the file deletion operation. The agent attempted to unlink the stale file '03_deliverables/legacy_validation/validation_report.json', but strict rules preventing the deletion of critical validation artifacts triggered a deadlock. This resulted in the stale file persisting, which caused the orchestrator to repeatedly read the old report showing 28 failed checks.
prescribed_behavior: The agent must employ an explicit override flag or invoke a dedicated state-purge routine designed specifically for legacy validation directories, ensuring that state cleanup operations can safely clear out stale validation reports without violating read-only dynamic invariant rules.
